title: [Angular] Error Messages in Preview after Installation via getstorybook
body:
### Issue details

After installing storybook via CLI I get the attached error from screenshot.

### Steps to reproduce

1.) go to existing angular-project
2.) npm i -g @storybook/cli
3.) getstorybook
4.) npm run storybook
